description: Public pages and their Next prefetches, for visitors without a session cookie: cache for the time their Cache-Control allows (deploy/CLOUDFLARE_PAGE_CACHE.md)
expression: (http.host eq "1think2win.com" and http.request.uri.path in {"/" "/faq" "/how-to-play" "/prizes" "/leaderboard" "/terms" "/privacy" "/disclaimer" "/contact"} and not http.cookie contains "-auth-token" and ((http.request.uri.query eq "" and not any(lower(http.request.headers.names[*])[*] eq "rsc")) or (starts_with(http.request.uri.query, "_rsc=") and len(http.request.uri.query) eq 21 and len(http.request.headers["rsc"]) eq 1 and http.request.headers["rsc"][0] eq "1")))
